name: @fezchat/github
description: GitHub in fez — repository activity in your chosen channels, with a thread per issue or pull request. Connects with a read-only, per-repo GitHub App over device flow; polls on the owner's machine and publishes to the relay, so teammates and agents without GitHub access still see the work.

scripts.build: esbuild src/headless.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/headless.js && esbuild src/connect.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/connect.js && esbuild src/gui.tsx --bundle --format=iife --global-name=__fezExt --platform=browser --jsx=transform --jsx-factory=h --outfile=dist/gui.js
